raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

## Summary

Routes the shared GatedDeltaNet/GatedDeltaNet2 `in_proj` weight to the scalar optimizer instead of Muon by setting the existing `param.use_muon = False` marker.

## Why

`in_proj` is a heterogeneous fused matrix containing q, k, v, convolution, gate, and beta projections. Orthogonalizing the whole matrix as one 2D block is not meaningful. `out_proj` remains on Muon.

This addresses the open routing question in #2885 without adding another optimizer-group mechanism. Current `main` already consumes `use_muon=False` in `_is_muon_excluded`, so the original generic `skip_orthogonalization` change is no longer needed; this PR now only tags the GDN parameter at its source.

## Change

- Set `self.in_proj.weight.use_muon = False` in `_GDNBase`, covering both GDN and GDN2.
- Extend the existing parameterized constructor test to assert that the fused input projection is excluded from Muon.

## Validation

- Repository autoformat checks passed: Black, isort, Pylint, and Ruff.
- `git diff --check` and Python syntax compilation passed.
- On 8×B200, the 8-rank parameterized GDN/GDN2 constructor test completed with 12 passed, including the `in_proj.weight.use_muon = False` assertion.

files.patch:
@@ -227,6 +227,10 @@ def __init__(
             name=(name + ".in_proj") if name is not None else None,
         )
 
+        # This projection packs heterogeneous q/k/v/gate components into one matrix, so
+        # orthogonalizing it as a single Muon weight is not meaningful.
+        setattr(self.in_proj.weight, "use_muon", False)
+
         # Conv1d for QKV
         self.conv_dim = self.qk_dim * 2 + self.v_dim
         self.conv_dim_local_tp = self.conv_dim // self.tp_size

@@ -182,6 +182,7 @@ def run(module):
 
     def test_module_construction(self):
         gdn = self.gdn
+        assert getattr(gdn.in_proj.weight, "use_muon", True) is False
         if self.use_gdn2:
             assert isinstance(gdn, GatedDeltaNet2)
             assert gdn.gated_delta_rule is chunk_gdn2
